core_obligations: Uniqueness (proof lines 714-717): any gamma- and delta-approximations agree on the common domain gamma cap delta = min(gamma, delta) by transfinite induction on the argument.

Existence by simple transfinite induction (lines 719-735): the empty function is the empty-approximation; from a gamma-approximation g the extension g + {(gamma, tau(g))} is a successor-approximation; at a limit, the union of all earlier approximations is the required function, using the agreement established in the uniqueness paragraph.
proof_roadmap: Fix the rule tau and the bound alpha.
Prove pairwise agreement of approximations by induction on the argument.
Build approximations upward: empty, successor extension, limit union.
Conclude existence and uniqueness for every gamma <= alpha.
